metadata.explanation: Variation of NBA store filtering task. User must apply 4 filters: women's category, Nike brand, hoodies type, and under $60 price. Evaluator checks all filters are present in HTML and URL, with no additional filters applied.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_direct_json_object metric and get_active_tab_html_parse getter. Pattern matches original task structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all 4 filter requirements (women, Nike, hoodies, under $60)
Getter logic correctly extracts filter presence from HTML elements with class 'filter-selector-link' using case-insensitive matching
URL validation provides redundant verification by checking if filter keywords appear in the page URL
Expected rules correctly specify all filters should be present (true) and no extra filters (is_other_exist: false)
Metric (check_direct_json_object) correctly compares result dict with expected dict for exact match
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts boolean presence → result keys are lowercase → expected keys match → metric compares
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified
